source: ui.json AscensionModeDescriptions TEXT; thresholds from every 'ascensionLevel >= N' check in the game classes
note: Ascension levels are cumulative: level N applies every level <= N. monsterStats=true means the level changes monster HP, damage or moves, so the bestiary should be shown at that level.

levels.summary: Elite rooms appear more often on the map (AbstractDungeon eliteRoomChance x1.6).
Normal enemies deal more damage (checked in 40 monster classes).
Elites deal more damage.
Bosses deal more damage.
Healing after a boss is reduced to 75% of missing HP (AbstractDungeon).
Start each run at 90% of Max HP (AbstractDungeon).
Normal enemies have more HP.
Elites have more HP.
Bosses (and boss minions Bronze Orb, Torch Head) have more HP.
Start each run with the Ascender's Bane curse in the deck.
One fewer potion slot (AbstractPlayer.potionSlots - 1).
Upgraded card reward chance halved in acts 2-4 (TheCity 0.25 -> 0.125; TheBeyond/TheEnding similarly).
Boss gold rewards are 75% (AbstractRoom); Mind Bloom's gold option is also reduced.
Lower starting Max HP (AbstractPlayer.getAscensionMaxHPLoss, per character).

Unfavorable events: worse numbers in Cleric, CursedTome, DeadAdventurer, Designer, FaceTrader, ForgottenAltar, Ghosts, GoldShrine, GoldenIdolEvent, GoopPuddle, GremlinMatchGame, GremlinWheelGame, Lab, MoaiHead, Nest, ScrapOoze, ShiningLight, Sssserpent, TheLibrary, TheMausoleum, WindingHalls, WomanInBlue; Note For Yourself is removed from the event pool.
Shop prices x1.1 (ShopScreen.applyDiscount(1.1)).
Normal enemies have harder movesets and abilities (34 monster classes).
Elites have harder movesets and abilities.
Bosses have harder movesets and abilities.
Double boss: a second boss fight at the end of act 3 (AbstractMonster/ProceedButton/TopPanel check bossList and level 20); score screens also read it.
